description: Two pilots with every skill in Amamake, docked at the Brutor Tribe Bureau, each in a Vexor. e2efc is the fleet's boss, a Vexor with nothing fitted: the scenario makes it invulnerable to rats. e2eflee is the companion: a 10MN afterburner, a medium armour repairer and five Hobgoblin IIs, so it tanks on armour, burns and has drones to leave behind.
